name: github
description: GitHub workflow, Actions monitoring, and rulesets management

reviewers.title: Extra reviewers
reviewers.description: Comma-separated logins that --bots treats as review bots, beyond the structural bot detection. Empty adds none.

ignore.title: Ignored commenters
ignore.description: Comma-separated logins whose pull request comments the watcher never sends to the session. Reviews still reach it. Empty ignores none.

ignoreBody.title: Ignored bot comments
ignoreBody.description: A regular expression. A bot's pull request comment whose body matches it is not sent to the session, beyond the built-in chatter rules. Empty adds none.

watch.title: Watch the pull request
watch.description: Watch the current branch's pull request in interactive sessions and show its state in the prompt footer.
